title: Powers and functions of the Board
text:
32. Powers and functions of the Board.—(1) Subject to any rules that may be made under this Act,

the general superintendence of all [auqaf] in a State shall vest in the Board established or the State; and it
shall be the duty of the Board so to exercise its powers under this Act as to ensure that the [auqaf] under
its superintendence are properly maintained, controlled and administered and the income thereof is duly
applied to the objects and for the purposes for which such [auqaf] were created or intended:
